items.title: Democratic Rep. Jimmy Gomez resigns after Ethics panel finds evidence of sexual misconduct
items.summary: Democratic Rep. Jimmy Gomez of California announced Monday that he will resign from Congress after the House Ethics Committee released a report finding "substantial evidence" he engaged in sexual misconduct by making unwelcome sexual advances and sexual contact toward a House staffer.

items.title: Huang's reinstatement at Nvidia sparks fury in Congress as lawmakers move forward with hearings
items.summary: Nvidia was already facing sharp scrutiny from Congress after Huang acknowledged a relationship with a Chinese businesswoman whom U.S. officials believed to be a spy. Putting Huang back in charge, after Trump said the board did "what we wanted them to do," raised stark concerns over the administration's role in the company that is central to the AI economy.
